title: Point Nemo में स्पेस स्टेशन क्यों डुबाते हैं? 🚀

cover.prompt: The International Space Station huge and close, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame, wrapped in orange flames with trailing black smoke and its panels breaking away, the deep-blue Pacific Ocean far below, calm dark star-filled space across the top, dramatic light, wide shot

fact_check.weak: fairly well-known viral fact; the ISS-400 km line is a nice twist but the payoff is not new to many

hook_score.why: The strongest hook: a vivid falling-station image plus a surprising paradox, asked as 'why', and it is easy to see in the first painting. It must be literally true, since stations do sometimes land on land, but the Short's answer covers that.
